entities.title: zazzle invoker source
entities.summary: The C source of the zazzle invoker: its logic, its entry point and a raw-syscall layer per platform.
entities.purpose: zazzle_core.h is the logic (exec a standalone tool, `zazzled wrap` or `zazzled proxy` for the commands that run as their own process; otherwise build the request, find or start the daemon, send the request with the standard streams and working directory, and return the daemon's status after a short spin); zazzle.c is the program around it; entry.h is the raw `_start` on Linux or `main` on macOS; sys.h picks the syscall backend for the platform, or the test mock, and adds thin wrappers including a non-blocking receive; sys_linux.h holds the Linux structure layouts and helpers shared by sys_linux_x86_64.h and sys_linux_aarch64.h; sys_darwin_arm64.h is the macOS arm64 backend; sys_arm64_clock.h is the arm64 timer and yield hint the spin uses on both arm64 platforms.
boundaries: Everything is header-only and compiled as one translation unit per program; bench/exit0.c reuses entry.h.
The wire protocol is the daemon's (macos/rust/zazzled/src/.dev/contracts.json, wire-protocol); this folder only speaks it.
No libc on Linux; on macOS it links libSystem only for its entry, the executable path, nanosleep and posix_spawn.
